---
title: Block quotes
author: Test Author
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: gold
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The gold preset styles a block quote in its own way, turns a closing dash paragraph into the attribution, keeps the decoration out of the tag tree, and keeps the text readable.
        check: bash _checks/quotes.sh gold
    mcanouil-typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['mc-preset = "gold"', 'attribution: \[']
---
